review.assessment:
The change removes a redundant `units.to_ckpa()` call on sensor readings that are already in cKPa, leaving only the conversion for the bench offset which arrives in hPa. This corrects the double-conversion of units that was pushing all reported pressures outside the expected range, directly addressing the batch job's false alerts. The host acceptance suite runs clean with no structural or veto failures.

No defects found.
